subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback contract, or should this PR align with the standard OTel resource path and the canonical OpenClaw resource-identity design?
rationale: The patch changes an operator-facing telemetry identity/default contract, and the canonical issue explicitly leaves the stable `service.instance.id` source as a maintainer/API decision.

options.title: Align With Standard OTel Identity
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through standard resource attributes or the approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID`, but docs, precedence, privacy expectations, and upgrade behavior should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Pause For Identity Design
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles the durable resource-identity contract.

recommendation.title: Align With Standard OTel Identity
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through standard resource attributes or the approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenTelemetry migration and diagnostics-otel maintenance history make this the best available routing candidate for the identity contract decision.
